applies_why: The judge text counts cited verses as unanswered witnesses against a link, which is exactly what K-G4 governs.
quote: CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN -- [L1] Matthew 1:18 ... and Matthew 1:25 ... contradict C3's claim of espousal union
rule_words: counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count
room: 'quotes the sentence ... and names that round': whether listing a verse as breaking a link suffices, versus requiring an explicit quote and round name; I read the rule as requiring both, which the text omits.
why: The judge treats the cited verses as unanswered witnesses without quoting any earlier-round sentence or naming any round, as the rule requires.
